words.example: The mid-year reviews for staff on probation start early in July.

words.example: We have taken on four registration clerks, year to date.
words.exampleZh: 年初至今，我们招了四名挂号文员。

words.exampleZh: 月初至今，加班时数已经超过月度目标。

words.exampleZh: 输液服务器上那张不受信任证书，让每台泵的浏览器都弹出了警告。

words.example: The expired cert on the patient portal started warning visitors at midnight.

words.example: The revoked cert was still presented by one old lab interface this morning.
words.exampleZh: 今天早上还有一个旧检验接口在出示已吊销证书。

words.meaning: 证书装订（Online Certificate Status Protocol）
words.example: The OCSP staple on the portal is stale, so some phones refuse the certificate.
words.exampleZh: 门户上的证书装订过期了，有些手机会拒绝这张证书。
